import base64,hashlib,json,zlib
from fractions import Fraction as F
from itertools import product
from pathlib import Path

R=Path('coordinacion/respuestas/AXIAL-TREE-COMPLETENESS-001-CODEX.json')
report=json.loads(R.read_bytes())
def sha(v):return hashlib.sha256(v).hexdigest()
def dg(v):return sha(json.dumps(v,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False).encode())
def raw_payload(path):
    r=json.loads(Path(path).read_bytes());run=r['test_run']
    raw=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(run['stdout_zlib_base64'],validate=True))
    assert sha(raw)==run['stdout_sha256'] and len(raw)==run['stdout_bytes']
    return json.loads(raw)
def rat(v):
    assert type(v) is list and len(v)==2 and all(type(x) is int for x in v) and v[1]>0
    return F(*v)
def word(w):
    assert type(w) is int and 0<=w<1<<32
    e,m=(w>>23)&255,w&0x7fffff
    assert e!=255 and not(e==0 and m)
    if not(e or m):return F(0)
    return (-1 if w>>31 else 1)*F((1<<23)+m)*F(2)**(e-150)
def xyz(words):return [sum(map(word,w),F(0)) for w in words]
def area(a,b,c):return (b[0]-a[0])*(c[1]-a[1])-(b[1]-a[1])*(c[0]-a[0])
def weights(t,point):
    a,b,c=[v[1:] for v in t];d=area(a,b,c);assert d!=0
    return [area(point,b,c)/d,area(a,point,c)/d,area(a,b,point)/d]
S=1<<149
for p,h in report['code_doc_sha256'].items():assert sha(Path(p).read_bytes())==h,p
a=raw_payload(R)
gcases=raw_payload('coordinacion/respuestas/AXIAL-GEOMETRY-WORDS-001-CODEX.json')['cases']
closed=raw_payload('coordinacion/respuestas/AXIAL-SCENE-CLOSURE-001-CODEX.json')['cases']
assert set(a['cases'])==set(gcases)==set(closed)
assert a['counts']=={'cases':13,'source_ids':14,'certified_cases':8,'records':27,'transitions':18,'primitive_checks_per_verification':72}
counters=dict(bindings=0,source_ids=0,records=0,transitions=0,primitive_partition_checks=0,
              original_configurations=0,family_corners=0,oracle_point_primitive_checks=0,certified_cases=0,geometry_stops=0)
for name,g in gcases.items():
    c=a['cases'][name];abi=g['word_ABI'];s=g['scene_snapshot'];ids=[v['id'] for v in s['sources']]
    binding=dg({'snapshot':s,'object_order':['M','D'],'source_order':ids})
    assert binding==abi['original_scene_binding_sha256'] and dg(abi)==g['word_ABI_sha256']
    assert c['retained_closure_gates_UNCHANGED']==closed[name]['stage_gates_retained']
    assert c['accepted_full_field_pipeline'] is False
    counters['bindings']+=1;counters['source_ids']+=len(ids)
    if not g['accepted_geometry_words_CPU_only']:
        assert c['geometric_tree_complete_restricted_CPU_only'] is False and c['record_count']==0
        counters['geometry_stops']+=1;continue
    counters['certified_cases']+=1
    w=c['certificate'];assert dg(w)==c['certificate_sha256']
    assert w['geometry_case_sha256']==dg(g) and w['word_ABI_sha256']==g['word_ABI_sha256']
    assert w['scene_binding_sha256']==binding and w['source_order']==ids and len(w['trees'])==len(ids)
    assert c['retained_phase_gates_UNCHANGED']==[p['accepted_phase_budget_CPU_only'] for p in g['sources']]
    ts=[xyz_t for xyz_t in ([xyz(v) for v in t['vertices_uint32_hilo']] for t in abi['triangles'])]
    planes={}
    orig_planes={}
    for owner,key in enumerate(('M','D')):
        v=list(map(lambda p:list(map(F,p)),s['objects'][key]['vertices_world_BU']))
        assert len({p[0] for p in v})==1;orig_planes[owner]=v[0][0]
        for index,face in enumerate(s['objects'][key]['faces']):
            pid=2*owner+index;t=ts[pid];enc=abi['triangles'][pid]
            assert enc['owner']==owner and len({p[0] for p in t})==1
            r=F(enc['X_radius_scaled'],S);x=t[0][0]
            for decoded,ix in zip(t,face):
                assert decoded[1:]==v[ix][1:] and abs(decoded[0]-v[ix][0])<=r
            if owner in planes:assert planes[owner]==(x-r,x+r)
            planes[owner]=(x-r,x+r)
    for i,(tree,src,row,enc) in enumerate(zip(w['trees'],s['sources'],g['sources'],abi['sources'])):
        assert len(tree)==3 and len({n['id'] for n in tree})==3
        assert [n['source_id'] for n in tree]==[ids[i]]*3
        assert [n['event'] for n in tree]==['source','reflect','detect']
        assert [n['id'] for n in tree]==[ids[i]+':'+k for k in ('root','mirror','det')]
        assert [n['parent'] for n in tree]==[None,tree[0]['id'],tree[1]['id']]
        assert [n['children'] for n in tree]==[[tree[1]['id']],[tree[2]['id']],[]]
        pos=xyz(enc['origin_uint32_hilo']);d=xyz(enc['direction_uint32_hilo']);sign=int(d[0])
        assert sign in (-1,1) and d==[F(sign),F(0),F(0)]==list(map(F,src['direction']))
        assert [n['direction_sign'] for n in tree]==[sign,-sign,None]
        assert pos[1:]==list(map(F,src['position_BU'][1:]))
        sr=F(enc['X_radius_scaled'],S);src_interval=(pos[0]-sr,pos[0]+sr)
        assert abs(F(src['position_BU'][0])-pos[0])<=sr
        assert tree[1]['origin_context']=='SAME-owner-0-X-variable'
        chosen=[row['segments'][j]['primitive_id'] for j in (0,1)]
        assert [n['arrival_primitive_id'] for n in tree]==[None,*chosen]
        classifications=[weights(t,pos[1:]) for t in ts]
        assert all(min(b)>0 or min(b)<0 for b in classifications)
        for j in (0,1):
            proof=tree[j]['next_primitive_partition']
            assert len(proof)==4 and [p['primitive_id'] for p in proof]==list(range(4))
            signj=sign if j==0 else -sign;origin=src_interval if j==0 else planes[0]
            for pid,p in enumerate(proof):
                owner=pid//2
                assert p['owner']==owner and list(map(rat,p['barycentric']))==classifications[pid]
                if min(classifications[pid])<0:relation='projected_miss'
                elif j==1 and owner==0:
                    relation='same_owner_departure';assert p['distance_BU']==[[0,1],[0,1]]
                else:
                    lo,hi=sorted([signj*(planes[owner][0]-origin[1]),signj*(planes[owner][1]-origin[0])])
                    assert list(map(rat,p['distance_BU']))==[lo,hi]
                    if hi<0:relation='behind'
                    else:
                        assert lo>0
                        relation='chosen' if pid==chosen[j] else 'strictly_later'
                        if relation=='strictly_later':
                            oo=chosen[j]//2
                            gap=planes[owner][0]-planes[oo][1] if signj>0 else planes[oo][0]-planes[owner][1]
                            assert gap>0 and rat(p['shared_origin_clearance_BU'])==gap
                assert p['relation']==relation
                counters['primitive_partition_checks']+=1
            assert proof[chosen[j]]['relation']=='chosen' and chosen[j]//2==j
            counters['transitions']+=1
        def oracle_tree(M,D,X):
            xplanes={0:M,1:D};x=X;direction=sign;departure=None
            for j in (0,1):
                positive=[]
                for pid in range(4):
                    counters['oracle_point_primitive_checks']+=1
                    owner=pid//2
                    if min(classifications[pid])<0:continue
                    if owner==departure:
                        assert x==xplanes[owner];continue
                    t=direction*(xplanes[owner]-x)
                    assert t!=0
                    if t>0:positive.append((t,pid))
                assert positive and len({p[0] for p in positive})==len(positive)
                winner=min(positive)[1]
                assert winner==chosen[j] and winner//2==j
                x=xplanes[j];departure=j;direction=-direction
        oracle_tree(orig_planes[0],orig_planes[1],F(src['position_BU'][0]))
        counters['original_configurations']+=1
        for M,D,X in product(planes[0],planes[1],src_interval):
            oracle_tree(M,D,X);counters['family_corners']+=1
        counters['records']+=3
assert counters=={'bindings':13,'source_ids':14,'records':27,'transitions':18,'primitive_partition_checks':72,
                  'original_configurations':9,'family_corners':72,'oracle_point_primitive_checks':648,
                  'certified_cases':8,'geometry_stops':5},counters
for key in ('GPU_executed','Bpy_executed','RT_executed','execution_authenticated',
            'physical_coherence_verified','accepted_full_field_pipeline','native_promotion_allowed',
            'geometry_signed512_graph_replayed','retained_writers_executed'):assert a[key] is False
assert report['test_run']['rc']==0 and report['test_run']['code_doc_sha256_at_run']==report['verification_code_inputs_at_run']
print(json.dumps({'passed':True,'pins_verified':len(report['code_doc_sha256']),'counts':counters,
